task_description: Build a modern Arabic text rephrasing tool as a static web application. The tool allows users to paste text and get it rephrased in a human-like style, with options for academic/journalistic/conversational tone, light/medium/deep rephrasing levels, automatic paragraph numbering, and suggested references. Uses OpenAI API (client-side) with user-provided API key stored in localStorage. Built with HTML + Tailwind CSS (CDN) + vanilla JavaScript, no build tools or package managers required.
